resolved_baseline.direct_wrapper_exception: Direct shell wrapper preserves a caller nonempty value; even string 0 is truthy and selects broad extra path unless safe/no-pcie. Do not infer absent from omitted CLI alone.

natural_vs_diagnostic.natural: MENU_LIVE_APP_INPUT and explicit service/model profile; no MENU_APPLY_MENU default
natural_vs_diagnostic.controlled_menu: MENU_APPLY_MENU=1 and original controller/lifecycle entry used for diagnosis; not natural cold boot evidence
natural_vs_diagnostic.both_entry: standard wrapper still runs real bootin; diagnostic intervention happens later in original AP lifecycle

public_success_reference.maintainer_reported: original simplified-Chinese selection, original 640x480 HUD and stable MENU via actual GTK mouse/key chain
public_success_reference.limit: Published success report and current source defaults are separate evidence; no assertion that private historic run had precisely absent MENU_EXTRA_MODULES.

imdb_filter.loop: VA1db20..21d80 step48(hex), name entry+16, mask entry+8; only lower3bits cleared; count/set/output SHA strict
imdb_filter.rationale_scope: qemu service/model platform filtering; exact reason of each entry not established from set declaration alone
imdb_filter.headless_state_requirement: hosd_claim scans /proc/modules and refuses if liro is loaded; source does not show LIRO in ten-item filter
imdb_filter.unresolved: Why original A7C2 LIRO did not remain Live in successful private run is not closed by retained published source. Failure/skip/current im target differences must not be guessed.
imdb_filter.cp_execution: AP software OSD and explicit software CP models do not establish original CP RAM/RTOS execution.

memory_reference.initrd_end: start + actual cpio bytes, DTB chosen matches loader
memory_reference.original_carveouts: official same-model kemco.txt all memrsv= lines except tmonitor appended to bootargs
memory_reference.model_reservations: DMM41e000000/1MiB; optional scanout41e100000/5MiB or combined9MiB; not actual Sony panel addresses
memory_reference.limit: Use FX3 original kemco and actual allocation owners; do not copy A7C2 carveouts. QEMU -m24576 is sparse address coverage, not a 24GiB host RAM requirement.
